seo.title: Wayfair: shoppable genAI interior images (Muse, Decorify) - more than 175,000 designs (2025)
seo.meta_description: Wayfair generates shoppable interior images with Muse, which replaces Decorify (more than 175,000 designs). The customer moves from a style idea to catalog products.
seo.resume_citable: Wayfair launched Muse in February 2025 to replace Decorify, its interior image generation tool that had produced more than 175,000 designs, connecting each generated scene to a catalog of about 30 million SKUs.

faq.a: Muse generates interior images from a style query and connects the scene to buyable Wayfair products, like a shoppable inspiration engine.

faq.q: How is it different from Decorify?
faq.a: Decorify started from a photo of the customer's room and proposed similar products. Muse, launched in 2025, starts from a style query and openly proposes items inspired by the generated scene.

objectif_business: Help the customer who does not know where to start move from a vague idea to a concrete scene, then to buyable products, in order to open up top-of-funnel discovery and feed conversion.
description: Wayfair first launched Decorify in the summer of 2023, a tool where the customer uploaded a photo of their room, chose a style, and received an AI-generated image, with similar Wayfair products offered as shoppable links. Decorify produced more than 175,000 designs since its launch, but it often distorted the architecture of rooms and started over from scratch with each new image. On February 11, 2025, Wayfair replaced Decorify with Muse, a Pinterest-style inspiration engine: the customer types a query such as moody 1920s style living room, browses AI-generated interior images, and clicks to see the closest products in the catalog of 30 million SKUs. Muse deliberately no longer tries to pixel-match a real product, and instead presents items inspired by the generated scene.

resultats.metrique: Designs generated by Decorify since its launch

niveau_preuve.justification: Official Wayfair release about Muse and major retail press (Retail Dive, Business of Home) naming the brand, with the figure of 175,000 designs for Decorify and the size of the catalog. No conversion or financial result published on the tool, which places it at C.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Real time on each inspiration query from the customer.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: Wayfair R&D and technology team, which maintains the image generation models and the catalog matching.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The relevance of the match between the generated image and the real catalog. If the mapping to the SKUs is weak, the customer sees a nice scene but products that are far off, and the move to purchase breaks.

etapes.detail: The customer describes a style or a room in natural language, or uploads a photo (Decorify).
The model generates an interior image matching the request.
The system connects the scene to catalog SKUs presented as inspired by the image.
The customer explores the proposed products, builds a collection, and adds to cart.

prerequis_data: Reference set of styles and room ambiances
Measurement loop from inspiration to purchase
prerequis_orga: Legal basis and minimization for customer-uploaded photos
Team able to maintain an image generation model
replication.premiere_etape: Train or plug in a room image generation model on the styles you sell, then connect each scene to buyable SKUs.

playbook.action: Frame the styles you sell and gather a reference image set per style.
playbook.livrable: Style reference set with examples validated by merchandising.

playbook.action: Plug in or fine-tune a room image generation model on these styles.
playbook.livrable: Generator producing coherent scenes per style, evaluated internally.
Product match rate measured on a sample of scenes.

playbook.action: Assemble the shoppable exploration interface, with disclosure that the images are AI-generated.
playbook.livrable: Accessible beta with an inspiration-to-product-page journey.

playbook.action: Instrument the funnel and decide on scaling.
playbook.livrable: Measured funnel: product click rate and conversion from inspiration.

replication.equipe: 1 PM + 2-3 ML engineers (image generation, visual search) + 1 designer + catalog team

stack_technique.detail: In-house genAI models that produce Muse's interior scenes (and before it Decorify's); the exact architecture is not published.
Inspiration engine launched February 11, 2025: style query, generated images, clickable inspired products.
Previous tool (2023-2025): uploaded room photo, generated restyling, similar products; more than 175,000 designs produced before its replacement by Muse.
Matching between the generated scene and the buyable SKUs from the catalog of about 30 million SKUs.

statut_vivant.note: Muse was launched on February 11, 2025 to replace Decorify and was active in the first quarter of 2025 (Business of Home and Dwell coverage). Tool accessible via wayfairnext.com/muse.

transposable_ue.note: Generating shoppable room images is transposable to any home furnishing e-commerce. In the EU, the AI Act requires disclosing that the visuals are AI-generated, and the use of room photos uploaded by the customer falls under GDPR (personal data to be handled with a legal basis and minimization).
